item.question: What are PPCA and LFA, and how are they used in modeling classes?
item.answer: PPCA (Probabilistic Principal Component Analysis) and LFA (Latent Factor Analysis) are methods for modeling data with latent variables. They estimate parameters from class-specific data to capture underlying structures for better classification.
